title: His attitude to music and life now
summary: He says he will go anywhere to play his horn and make a living.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Any other questions? Dick, do we want to finish up with Mandeville? No, I don't think I think we better get on out. All right, unless you have something you want to add about your life to fill out something in a minute?

Oh, my life, I tell you all, my life is up now, just the way I feel about music now, you know. I play music so long when I'm getting too old to do anything else. And anywhere where I can play my horn and make a living, it's not too full for me to go. You understand? I'll go any place so I can be happy playing my horn and making a living.
